name.title: Hey! What would you like to call me?
name.lede: Pick any name you like. It is also my wake word: say it out loud, and I'm listening. You can change it anytime in Settings.
name.label: Assistant name

connect.title: Connect your AI
connect.lede: Sign in with a subscription you already pay for, or paste an API key. One of them is enough for {name} to think and talk.
connect.finish_in_browser: Finish the sign-in in your browser.
connect.install_first: Install it first: run this in a terminal, then check again.
connect.key_partial: Some parts did not switch ({parts}). You can fix them later on the API Keys page.
connect.live_ready: Live voice is on: talk, and {name} answers right away.
connect.live_missing: Chat works. Live voice needs an OpenAI or Gemini key; until then {name} speaks the classic way, a little slower.
connect.key_security: Subscriptions are billed at a flat monthly price. Keys go into your system's keychain and only ever to the provider you picked.
connect.nothing_yet: Nothing connected yet. Without a subscription or a key, chat and voice stay off. You can connect one later on the API Keys page.

voice.title: How you'll talk to {name}
voice.lede: Type in the chat, or just speak: say your wake word, or press your Call shortcut.
voice.call_detail: Press it anywhere to start talking. Click the keys to choose your own.
voice.call_recording: Hold the keys you want, then let go. Esc cancels.
voice.call_none: No shortcut yet. Click the field and press the keys you want.
voice.call_saved: Saved. Press it anywhere to start talking.
voice.call_refused: This combination can't be used. Try another one.
voice.wake_on: Always listening for your wake word. It is recognised right here on this computer.
voice.wake_off: Off: press your Call shortcut to talk. Turn it on to have your wake word heard all the time.
voice.wake_switch: Always listen for the wake word
voice.after_restart: This switches on with the restart at the end.
voice.login_detail: Opens {name} when your computer starts, so it is ready to hear you.
voice.preview_note: This is a replay, so nothing restarts.
voice.restart_note: Next, a short walk shows you around the app. At the end the app restarts once (about ten seconds) to switch everything on.

tour.title: A walk through {name}
tour.lede: Your pet walks you through the app and explains each section.

stops.chat: Hi, I'm {pet}! Let me show you around. This is your chat with {name}. Type anything here: a question, a task, a file to look at. You never pick a tool or a model yourself; {name} decides what's needed.
stops.voice: Rather talk? This is voice chat. Click the bar, say your wake word or press your Call shortcut, then just speak. The wave shows who is talking.
stops.agents: Big jobs like research, a report or a website go to your agents. They're {name}'s team, each with its own role and model. Open Agents to watch them work, chat with one or create your own.
stops.ide: The Agentic IDE runs coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex in real terminals, on your own projects. Type to them directly, or let {name} steer them by voice.
stops.plugins: Plugins connect {name} to the apps you use: mail, calendar, notes, smart home and more. Each one becomes a new tool, and anything that sends or changes something asks you first.
stops.wake: Your wake word lives here in Settings. Say "Hey {name}" and {name} listens. Change the word, pick its language or test it anytime.
stops.done: That's the tour! Talk to {name} whenever you like, and if you're ever stuck, just ask. Settings → App runs this guide again.

local_model.title: Use a free local model
local_model.hint: Runs on this computer, free and private. Installs Ollama if needed and downloads a model that fits.
local_model.first_answer_slow: The first answer can take a minute while the model loads.
local_model.error_remote: Ollama runs on another computer, so this app cannot install or start it. Start it there, then try again.
local_model.error_install: Ollama could not be installed. If your antivirus blocked the download, allow it and try again.
local_model.error_start: Ollama is installed but did not start.
local_model.error_no_model: No model fits this computer. Connect a provider in Settings instead.
local_model.error_download: The download stopped. Try again: it continues where it stopped.
local_model.error_select: The model is downloaded but could not be selected.

conversation.label: Introduction
conversation.hello: Hi, I'm {name}. Three quick questions so I can help you from day one. You can skip any of them.
conversation.ask_name: First: what should I call you?
conversation.ask_help: What do you want help with? Pick as many as you like.
conversation.ask_accounts: Which accounts should I connect? Anything that sends or changes something asks you first.
conversation.accounts_none: No accounts to offer right now.
conversation.accounts_later: You can connect more anytime in Plugins.
conversation.ask_model: One more thing: nothing that can answer is connected yet. A free local model runs on this computer and costs nothing.
conversation.model_later: Later, I'll connect a provider in Settings
conversation.done: All set. Ask me anything: type below or start a call.
conversation.done_named: All set, {user}. Ask me anything: type below or start a call.

app_tour.replay_body: Opens the setup window again (name, AI connections, voice), then the walk through the app. Nothing restarts.
